query: 环境策略与政策声明 环境策略与政策声明 衡量企业环境战略、政策承诺及治理机制完整性。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的环境政策，涵盖全价值链边界；设定了科学的短期与中长期环境目标；明确了董事会及高管层的专项职责，且披露了明确的政策审议与修订频率。 • 1分（合格）：发布了正式的环境政策声明，包含基础的管理目标和职责分配，但在政策边界描述、目标的科学性或董事会实质性参与方面披露不足。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式环境政策披露，或仅有碎片化的环保措施描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：环境政策覆盖 >80% 的业务单元、子公司、生产基地及核心经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅适用于集团总部/部分区域，或未说明政策在全集团的推行范围。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 环境政策 环境策略 环境管理体系 政策边界 董事会环境监督 政策审议频率 集团环境政策 ISO 14001 EMS environmental policy environmental strategy environmental management system policy boundary board oversight of environment policy review frequency group-wide environmental policy ISO 14001 EMS 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '环境策略与政策声明'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否发布正式环境政策或策略声明？ 政策边界是否覆盖全价值链或主要业务？ 是否设定短期与中长期环境目标？ 董事会或高管的环境职责如何规定？ 政策审议与修订频率是什么？ 政策覆盖哪些业务单元或地区？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有零散环保项目；仅有排放数据表；仅有合规许可证列表；仅有“绿色发展”口号；仅有ISO 14001证书或EMS名称而无正式环境政策、管理目标和职责分配。区分：本指标关注企业环境政策、目标、职责、审议机制及覆盖；供应商环境标准关注供应链准入；ESG监督委员会是治理架构。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

The Board takes full responsibility for the ESG development of China SCE and is committed to establishing a culture of good governance to safeguard the interests of stakeholders and respond to community expectations. With increasing social and international concern over the corporate ESG performance, the Board leads the Group's departments in developing, approving and implementing policies and measures to manage ESG issues in order to minimise the environmental and social impact of the Group's operations and to identify related risks at an early stage. The Board will also continue to enhance its involvement in ESG work, maintain regular meetings with management and review progress and effectiveness in order to establish a top-down governance model.

results.text: In order to meet the market needs and the current requirements of corporate development, the Group clearly recognises that the cooperation with suppliers should be transformed from a purely beneficial need to a long-term partnership or even a strategic alliance in order to support the large-scale development of the business in a high quality and efficient manner. A shared vision of development is a prerequisite for the formation of trusting and win-win partnerships and alliances, including the pursuit of sustainable development. Currently, the Group has regarded environmental protection risk and social and governance risk of suppliers as one of the criteria for the review of supplier cooperation, and standardised management is carried out to more effectively reduce the negative impact of the supply chain on the Group's operation. In addition, the Group encourages contractors and subcontractors to use more eco-friendly equipment and facilities, as well as adopt new eco-friendly technologies, hoping to prevent pollution and reduce resource utilisation together with the construction unit during the construction stage, so as to reduce the impact on the environment.

為適應市場形勢的需要及企業當前發展的要 求,本集團清晰認識到,與供應商的合作應從 單純利益需要向長期的夥伴、甚至戰略聯盟轉 型,才能高質高效地支持業務規模化發展。共 同的發展理念是形成具備信任與共贏的夥伴及 聯盟關係的必備條件,括對可持續發展的追 求。目前,本集團已將供應商環境保護風險及 社會及管治風險作為供應商合作評審標準之 一,進行標準化管理,以更有效地減少供應鏈 對本集團運營的負面影響。此外,本集團鼓勵 承商和分商使用更環保的設備及設施,以 及採用更環保的新技術,希望在施工階段,與 施工單位一起防止污染及減少資源使用,減低 對環境的影響。
